title: Akamai Soars After Massive AI Cloud Deal Shock
source_used: TradingKey (the TipRanks page returned 403); Quiver Quantitative and Simply Wall St read for context
key_facts: Akamai stock moved up 7.53% on 9 October 2026, according to TradingKey.
The move is tied to Akamai's seven-year cloud computing agreement with Anthropic, valued at $11.6 billion.
The deal was announced on 24 September 2026 (Reuters, GlobeNewswire and others dated 24 Sep).
Analysts cited by TradingKey question the return on the deal, which requires $5.5 billion of capital spending including $1.7 billion in 2026, weighing on free cash flow.
Akamai's core content delivery business is reported down 6% year on year with operating margins down from 30% to 25%.
Akamai has set its third-quarter results call for early November.
quote_evidence: Akamai secured a seven-year cloud computing agreement with Anthropic.
Akamai Technologies Inc (AKAM) moved up by 7.53%.
why_it_matters_hint: No new deal terms; the news is the share-price reaction to a deal announced on 24 Sep.
event_date: Deal announced 24 Sep 2026; share move 9 Oct 2026
notes: TipRanks page blocked; TradingKey is a market-data site and its article may include AI-generated content. The 24 Sep date comes from headlines of Reuters, GlobeNewswire, WSJ and others in Google News, not from an article read in full. Other coverage of the same day gives different share-move figures (Traders Union headline: 3.77%).
